US Senator Rubio Explains India's Russian Oil Sanctions Exemption

US Senator Marco Rubio has clarified that exemptions granted to India regarding Russian oil sanctions were considered alongside the India-US trade deal. Rubio's remarks address the question of why India might face sanctions for purchasing Russian oil while the US might receive exemptions. The explanation was provided in response to queries about the differential treatment.
